sourceCollection: User-provided Iconsax icon library, icons/rounded/outline (rounded outline variant)
scope: Status row shuffle badge plus the install/download, upload, new file and rename action glyphs. Original SVG bytes and geometry are preserved.
processing: SVG XML inspected for active content and external references. Application renders the artwork with a currentColor alpha mask.
rights: Copied from the user-provided local icon library at the user’s direction. No separate redistribution license has been inferred. The project source license does not relicense these assets.
